summary: First-iteration full-stack test of LaunchPilot (FastAPI + React + Mongo). Backend: 39/39 pytest cases pass — auth (register/login/me/logout/emergent-session), projects CRUD + redeploy, audits (Claude returns non-empty issues + recommendations), leads search/filters/detail, outreach generation (Claude), campaigns CRUD, CRM kanban + stage updates, dashboard stats. Frontend: landing, signup, demo login, sidebar nav across all pages, project creation, audit run with scored table render, leads grid (50 cards) + search/filter, lead detail with Claude outreach draft generation (subject + body), CRM kanban (7 stages) + add contact, settings showing demo email and 'coming soon' integration notes. All wired with no broken integrations.

ui_bugs.issue: React warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key prj_xxxxxx' after creating a project — list likely optimistically appends a row AND refetches, producing a duplicate key for one render

action_items: (low) In Deployments.jsx, dedupe state after create — either rely solely on the POST response OR skip the immediate refetch — to remove the duplicate-key React warning.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: JWT cookie uses samesite='none'; secure=True — correct for cross-site preview env; OK.
audits.py: scores are deterministic from URL hash (good for demo). Real Claude call provides issues/recommendations; verified non-empty in tests.
outreach.py shares router prefix='/api' (mounts both /outreach/* and /campaigns/*) — works but mixing prefixes is unusual; consider splitting routers per resource for clarity.
crm.py /dashboard/stats lives inside crm router — minor naming concern (could be in its own dashboard router) but not a bug.
leads.py ensure_seed() seeds 120 docs synchronously on startup AND on each /leads call — second call is cheap (count check) but consider relying on startup only.
All routes correctly exclude _id from Mongo responses. No 5xx encountered.
Backend supports BOTH Authorization Bearer and cookie session_token (require_user) — verified.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows tested passed (landing, auth, nav, projects, audits, leads, lead-detail outreach, CRM, settings). 1 low-severity React key warning.

seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_-prefixed projects, campaigns and contacts (all deleted in their own tests). Frontend test created 'QA Test Project' (deployment) and 'QA Tester @ QA Co' (CRM contact) under demo user — these persist; minor cleanup that main agent may ignore.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints validated via /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — re-run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. Claude integration is live and adds ~5–10s latency to /api/audits and /api/outreach/generate; tests use 90s timeouts. Frontend uses data-testid attributes uniformly. Leads list renders as cards (data-testid='lead-row-<id>'), not <tr>. The only known minor issue is a React duplicate-key warning on Deployments after project creation — non-blocking.
